SECONDAMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISSECONDAMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Second Amendment"), made as of December 19 2019, by and between MEILMAN FAMILY REAL ESTATE, LLC d/b/a 413 West 14"h Associates, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 421 West 14h Street, Suite 421 3R, New York, New York 10014 (Transferor") and LM LEGACY GROUP LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 421 West 14th Street, Suite 421 3R, New York, New RECITALS: A. Transferor is the owner of certain parcels of land known as Tax Lots 14, 21 and 51 in Block 712 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the (said land being herein referred to collectively as “Transferor's Land"). B.Transferee is the owner of certain land adjacent to Transferor's Land, known as Tax Lot 42 in Block 712 on the Tax Map,more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to collectively as "Transferee'sLand"). C. Pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated as of May 20, 2008, by and between 413 West 14th Associates (as predecessor-in-interest to Transferor) and Transferee, and recorded May 27, 2008 in the Office of the City Register (the "Register's Office") under City Register File Number ("CRFN") 2008000212531, Transferor's Land and Transferee's Land were declared to be a single “zoning lot" (as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to date, the “Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the“Combined Zoning Lot"). D. Pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot and Development Agreement, dated as of May 20, 2008, by and between 413 West 14rh Associates (as predecessor-in-interest to Transferor) and Transferee, and recorded May 27, 2008 in the Register's Office under CRFN 2008000212530,andamendedbythatcertainAmendmenttoZoningLotDevelopment Agreement, dated as of July 18, 2017, and recorded August 17, 2017 in the Register's Office under CFRN 2017000306652 (as amended, the“Original ZLDA"), the Floor AreaDevelopment Rights (as defined in the Original ZLDA) appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot were allocated between Transferor's Property (as defined in the Original ZLDA) and Transferee's Property (as defined in the Original ZLDA).
